'''Malidris'''<ref name="SECR">''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game Saga Edition Core Rulebook]]''</ref> was the [[City/Legends|city]] that served as [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Iridonia/Legends|Iridonia]].

==History==
[[File:Capital_square.jpg|thumb|left|180px|[[Capital Square]] viewed from [[Luke Skywalker's chambers (Iridonia)|Luke Skywalker's chambers]].]]

Malidris was host to the [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] council that governed the world and esteemed guests were lodged in apartments near the [[Capital Square]].

The city was visited at one point by [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] as an [[Ambassador/Legends|ambassador]] for the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. He ventured to the planet to help with opening new [[Hyperspace route/Legends|trade routes]] to the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], but became embroiled in an investigation into a mysterious [[Force ghost/Legends|ghostly]] apparation said to be the deceased [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]].

Tracking down the apparition which had a strong presence in [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], Skywalker found the laboratory of [[Drell Kahmf]] a mad [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] scientist who claimed to have salvaged the brain of Maul and was using it in conjunction with a [[solid-state hologram]] to help Maul get revenge and restore his reputation. Appalled at this experiment, Skywalker switched off the machine keeping the brain alive.
